traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China (Buddleja davidii): shrubs 0.5-5 m; young branchlets, leaves abaxially, petioles and inflorescences white tomentose with stellate hairs. Petiole 1-5 mm; blade narrowly ovate, narrowly elliptic or very narrowly ovate, 4-20 x 0.3-7.5 cm, adaxially dark green, base cuneate, margin serrate, apex acuminate, lateral veins 9-14 pairs. Inflorescences terminal thyrsoid cymes, 4-30 x 2-5 cm. Corolla violet to dark purple, sometimes white, with an orange-yellow throat, 0.8-1.4 cm. Fl. May-Oct.
